field_text_formatted.value: Consumer Node Preview shows what's still in the edit form, before a revision exists, so editors check a change without saving it first. The trade-off is that nobody else can open that preview. When a reviewer needs a link, Next.js for Drupal's draft mode previews a saved revision, and its signed link can go to them.
